items.evidence: Normal, seed 1, full bot run replayed in leverage play: wave 6 sends 15 runners (kind runner, health 1, 0.05 u/tick = 3 u/s; score 450->675 = 15x15). But they come 46 ticks apart (about 0.77 s), not 1.5 s: at tick 5180 runners are at x=17.6 (born 5132) and x=19.9 (born 5178). spawn_cd=45 in lib.rs.

HUD reads 'Wave N of 6' / 'Oleada N de 6' / 'Vague N sur 6'. Wave 5 cleared: still play at ticks 4960 and 5100 (wave 5, not won). Wave 6 starts at 5132. Full clear: won at 5885, score 675, gate 5. Bot that kills all but the last runner: it goes through the gate and the game is won at 6176 with gate 4, score 660.

Enter on Language cycles en->es->fr->en; Right goes en->es->fr. French texts: title ['Défendez la porte','Commencer','Réglages','Quitter'], settings ['Réglages','Volume : 5','Langue : Français','Difficulté : Normal','Retour'], play ['Score : 0','Vague 1 sur 6','Porte : 5'], paused ['Pause','Reprendre','Titre'], won ['Vous avez gagné','Score : 675','Entrée : titre'], lost ['Vous avez perdu','Score : 0','Entrée : titre']. Frames viewed show the same.

Settings texts: Volume, Language, 'Difficulty: Normal', Back. Focus index 2 is Difficulty. Right -> Hard, Left -> Easy (stops at the ends), default normal. Shown as 'Dificultad: Normal' in Spanish and 'Difficulté : Normal' in French. Frame setdiff.png shows it marked between Language and Back.

Walker health at spawn with settings folders: easy 1, normal 2, hard 3. Wave 6 runners: easy 1 (tick 5070, seed 1), normal 1 (tick 5134), hard 2 (tick 5400, seed 2). Changing Hard->Easy mid-session via pause/title/settings gives health-1 walkers on the next Start.

One run set volume 7, fr, easy -> settings.json holds all three; the next run with the same folder starts 7/fr/easy (French title). A hand-made old-style settings.json {volume:3, language:es} loads as 3/es with difficulty normal and walkers of health 2. A fresh folder gives 5/en/normal.
State JSON has "difficulty":"normal"/"easy"/"hard"; each walker has "kind":"walker" or "runner". All 18 --frame PNGs I wrote have the PNG signature and an 800x480 IHDR.
Re-ran each item that passed before; all still pass (details in the m items). m09, which failed before, still spaces spawns 91 ticks apart and is not held against the change.
CHANGES.md lists the three changes with files (lib.rs, assets/strings/fr.json, game.json, assets/ui/settings.json), what was checked with leverage play, the earlier faults found, and the limits.

defects: Runner spawn interval is 46 ticks (0.767 s); even the builder's stated 0.75 s is off by one tick, the same off-by-one as walkers (91 ticks).
Left/Right on Language and Difficulty stop at the ends instead of wrapping (Enter wraps); not against the list, noted only.
